Home.eyebrow: Built for Qatar's modern property teams
Home.description: Organize property inventory, prepare Arabic and English listings with AI, publish through approved portal connections, and manage enquiries in one beautifully simple workspace.
Home.heroNote: One source of truth · Human-approved AI · Fully bilingual
Home.flowTitle: From property details to serious enquiries.
Home.flowSub: Four connected steps. No scattered spreadsheets or disconnected inboxes.
Home.step1Text: Create a canonical listing with structured property facts and room-tagged media.
Home.step2Text: Generate polished bilingual drafts; your team checks and approves every claim.
Home.step3Text: Validate each destination's requirements, then publish with reliable job tracking.
Home.step4Text: Unify enquiries, assign owners, and respond faster with assisted workflows.
Home.featuresTitle: One connected operating system for property teams.
Home.feature1Text: Structured intake, quality checks, bilingual drafts, review and approval.
Home.feature2Text: Capability-aware connectors, field mappings, idempotent publishing and audit logs.
Home.feature3Text: Trace every enquiry to the right property, channel and responsible teammate.
Home.feature4Text: Grounded suggestions, approved campaign drafts and effortless human handover.
Home.ctaTitle: Give your portfolio a better workflow.
Home.ctaText: Start with the workspace demo, then connect your real systems one integration at a time.
